crop.notes: Clipping is a long column of sporting notes, ads and city news; only one paragraph in the 'Tips' section (crop-2) is about Allen.

ocr.notes: The Allen paragraph is mostly readable; the top of the column (billiards item) is heavily garbled.

title.suggested: Tom Allen Plans to Return to America

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen had announced over his own signature that he planned to return to America in a few months, news expected to stir ring circles.

metadata.notes: Masthead too blurry to read the date; page 3; contents (New York, March 27 dispatch) fit 1880-03-28.

facts.fact: Allen, then abroad in England, announced over his own signature that he planned to return to America within a few months

notes: Item is one sentence; England is implied (Allen went to England in 1877), not named in the paragraph.
